creation.verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

m01.title: Tend the Garden
m01.desc: God placed Adam in the garden to work it and take care of it.

steps.explore: Walk to the garden plot by the river
steps.seeds: Gather seeds from the wild grain ({n}/{total})
steps.gourd: Take the gourd by the river
steps.fill: Fill the gourd at the river

m02.title: The LORD God's Command
m02.desc: Of every tree you may freely eat — except one.

steps.follow: Walk with the LORD God to the midst of the garden
steps.trees: Look at the two trees in the midst of the garden ({n}/{total})

m03.title: Naming the Animals
m03.desc: God brought the animals to Adam to see what he would call them.

steps.go: Go to the LORD God in the meadow
steps.name: Name the animals ({n}/{total})

m04.title: Bone of My Bones
m04.desc: It is not good that the man should be alone.

steps.rest: Lie down to rest under the great oak

m05.title: Gifts of the Garden
m05.desc: Every tree pleasant to the sight and good for food.

steps.basket: Adam: take the basket near the orchard
steps.gather: Eve: pick fruit in the orchard ({n}/{total})
steps.share: Bring the fruit to the clearing in the orchard

m06.title: The Serpent
m06.desc: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field.

steps.go: Walk to the midst of the garden

m07.title: Coverings of Fig Leaves
m07.desc: Their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked.

steps.leaves: Each takes leaves from a fig tree ({n}/{total})
steps.sew: Sew the leaves together at the flat stone

m08.title: Hiding Among the Trees
m08.desc: They heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden.

steps.grove: Go into the grove as evening falls
steps.answer: Come out and answer the LORD God

m10.title: East of Eden
m10.desc: So he drove out the man.

steps.leave: Walk east, out of the garden

gen2_15.text: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

gen2_20.text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

gen2_22.text: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

gen3_6.text: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

gen3_21.text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

gen3_24.text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

m02_command.t: Eat freely from every tree — but not from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. The day you eat of it, you will surely die.

m02_forbidden.t: The tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

m03_intro.t: It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.

m04_wake.t: This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. She shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

m04_switch.t: Gameplay: press {switch} to play as Adam or Eve.

m05_intro.t: Let us gather fruit — from every tree but one.

m05_share.t: Every tree is a gift — all but the one in the midst.

m06_serpent.t: Did God really say, “You shall not eat of any tree of the garden”?
We may eat from the trees, but not from the one in the midst, or we will die.
You will not surely die. God knows your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.

m08_hide.t: Gameplay: hide until time runs out.

m08_answer.t: I heard your voice and was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid.
Did you eat from the tree I commanded you not to eat from?
The woman you gave me — she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate.
What is this that you have done?
The serpent deceived me, and I ate.

m09_serpent.t: You are cursed; on your belly you will go. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.

m09_woman.t: In pain you will bear children. You will long for your husband, and he will rule over you.

m09_adam.t: The ground is cursed because of you; it will bring thorns and thistles. Dust you are, and to dust you will return.

m10_intro.t: The man now knows good and evil. He must not take from the tree of life and live forever.

examine.treeOfLife: The tree of life, in the midst of the garden. (Genesis 2:9)
examine.forbiddenTree: The tree of the knowledge of good and evil. (Genesis 2:17)
examine.forbiddenAfter: The tree in the midst of the garden.
examine.river: A river went out of Eden to water the garden. (Genesis 2:10)
examine.plantGrown: The plants you tended are growing well.
examine.animalUnnamed: An animal of the garden. It has not been named yet.
examine.exitBlocked: This path leads out of the garden. Adam's place is here, in Eden — for now.

toasts.evePicks: Eve picks the fruit. {key} to switch.
